mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Public Library. Under the Waning Gibbous moon, space fans should look up at 3:29 AM to catch the International Space Station as it passes from the Northwest near Verona High School toward the Northeast near Home Depot.

September 2026 is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona. Mayor Luke Diaz is calling on all of us to help address the systemic issues of food insecurity that affect 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin through volunteering and advocacy.
There is plenty to do around town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with brain-teasing fun, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In a notable call from the past week, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Dove. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
